title: Shadowbearer: Dawn's Return
production_status: Promoted Unreal Engine 5.8 native adventure; the internal compatibility id remains cubetown for saves and the installed route
current_floor: V25R26 Shadowbearer: Dawn's Return promoted release; preserve the complete Dawn-to-First-Eclipse story, native runtime, public identity, canonical illustrated world map, startup-to-gameplay input guarantee, packaged runtime evidence, and rollback record
next_target: Future successors build from the promoted V25R26 floor in an isolated candidate; V25R26 remains the no-regression floor until a newer candidate passes both candidate and installed packaged-runtime proof and is promoted
core_fantasy: A handcrafted storybook action-adventure where Zane survives Shadowfall, projects light to make shadow physically real, restores five fallen guardians and their armaments, confronts Aktarus at the Black Meridian, and carries light and darkness into Dawn's Return.
design_pillars: Zane is a readable production adventure character with complete locomotion, guard, dodge, attack, hit, and traversal presentation — never a default pawn or permanently idling mesh.
Projected light, held shadow, Memorycraft, returned souls, and guardian armaments are physical world and combat systems, not passive inventory text.
Bramblewick before and after Shadowfall anchors the emotional arc through Sera, Mara, Tess, Vara, Brann, Orin, and the Pale Warden.
The five Returned guardians and Aktarus history lead into the Black Meridian finale, Dawn's Return, and persistent First Eclipse postgame.

The canonical illustrated map is the macro-geography shown directly in the M-key world-map overlay: Velmor Keep, Ashenwold, The Sunken Court, Stonehelm Mountains, Duscreach Desert, The Shattered Coast, and The Black Spire. Story locations nest inside those regions; optional world bosses expand the world without replacing the release-critical story arc.
Every opening frame must show authored natural depth, readable traversal, warm light against held shadow, and a clear destination across foreground, midground, and background.

visual_identity.hero: Zane the Shadowbearer — athletic hooded adventurer with a production Rogue-based silhouette, readable blade and guard language, grounded field gear, and complete movement and combat states.
visual_identity.world: Natural storybook PBR: Bramblewick warmth, restrained teal shadow, projected dawnlight, moss, timber, stone, forests, markets, warrens, skyfall heights, Vesperhold, and Black Meridian depth.
visual_identity.hud: Minimal near-black glass with teal, cream, and controlled gold accents; story, combat tells, objectives, health, and resources stay readable without generic sci-fi chrome or purple-blue gradients.

forbidden_crossovers: Do not copy or imitate Nintendo, Zelda, Minecraft, Fortnite, Genshin, Pixar, or any other existing franchise.
Do not import Phantom Ages lane-battle controls or age progression.
Do not import Phantom Legends RTS selection or settlement economy.
Do not resurrect voxel block placement or the retired Maker identity as the primary public game; world manipulation uses Memorycraft and projected shadow.
Do not replace the existing multi-engine Cubetown web source; keep it as compatibility reference.
release_policy: V25R26 is documented as promoted on 2026-08-23 with the canonical map SHA-256 316F4351143C36886B350D7AEA41D66F2CDC38E836A05AD900ECC0A40DF30E1C, a Shadowbearer-only candidate, matching installed package hashes, stable compatibility path, rollback path, save-isolated proof mode, and fresh candidate plus installed Shipping-runtime proof that exits the prologue, releases move input, moves, turns, jumps, lands, animates, and preserves character integrity. Future revisions must package to a new isolated candidate, pass focused gates and both runtime proofs, preserve the exact map or an explicitly approved successor, and retain rollback readiness before replacing this floor.
